BiblicalUsage: Elishaphat is an Israelite. In 2 Chronicles 23:1, the text says "and Elishaphat the son of Zichri."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elishaphat matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
